name: argos
description: Argos, a simple and easy-to-use Agent client
author: dvaJi

scripts.lint: bun run lint:agent-cleanup && bun run lint:architecture && bun run lint:route-catalog && oxlint --deny-warnings .
scripts.build:unpack: bun run build && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.build:mac: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun run plugin:cua:build && bun run plugin:bundle -- --name cua --platform darwin && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.build:mac:arm64: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun run plugin:cua:build:mac:arm64 && bun run plugin:bundle -- --name cua --platform darwin --arch arm64 && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64
scripts.build:mac:x64: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun run plugin:cua:build:mac:x64 && bun run plugin:bundle -- --name cua --platform darwin --arch x64 && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --x64
scripts.build:win: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.build:win:x64: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64
scripts.build:win:arm64: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --arm64
scripts.build:linux: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.build:linux:x64: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux --x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64: bun run build:daemon && bun run build && bun run plugin:bundle:clean && bun x electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux --arm64
scripts.installRuntime: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk
scripts.installRuntime:win:x64: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 -a x64 -p win32 && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep -a x64 -p win32 && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk -a x64 -p win32
scripts.installRuntime:win:arm64: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 -a arm64 -p win32 && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep --runtime-version 15.1.0 -a arm64 -p win32 && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk -a arm64 -p win32
scripts.installRuntime:mac:arm64: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 -a arm64 -p darwin && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep -a arm64 -p darwin && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk -a arm64 -p darwin
scripts.installRuntime:mac:x64: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 -a x64 -p darwin && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep -a x64 -p darwin && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk -a x64 -p darwin
scripts.installRuntime:linux:x64: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 -a x64 -p linux && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep -a x64 -p linux && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk -a x64 -p linux
scripts.installRuntime:linux:arm64: bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type uv --dir ./runtime/uv --runtime-version 0.9.18 -a arm64 -p linux && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type ripgrep --dir ./runtime/ripgrep -a arm64 -p linux && bun x tiny-runtime-injector --type rtk --dir ./runtime/rtk -a arm64 -p linux
